queries.query: Turn these incident notes into a reusable Agent Skill. Decide its role, when it should be selected, and what nearby work it should exclude; keep the detailed procedure in the body.

Rewrite this complete Agent Skill so its role, description, body structure, references, scripts, and evaluation plan form one coherent package. Preserve supported behavior, but re-evaluate the whole skill.

We have an old project-specific prompt bundle. Migrate it into an Agent Skill, moving execution detail into the body or a reference and preserving supported source task families.
Fix this SKILL.md's frontmatter, body structure, and reference paths so it conforms to Agent Skills, without changing unrelated application code.
